rationale: Pranav is building AI-powered applications with a focus on LLM fine-tuning and agentic systems, while Junfan is a 5+ year AI researcher at Saturday Robotics specializing in agentic reinforcement learning and LLM/VLM systems—they share deep conviction in LLM-tooling and agentic AI as core problem-solving domains. Junfan's extensive open-source work on LangGraph and agentic frameworks, combined with mentorship willingness, directly complements Pranav's developer-first approach and hunger to deepen applied AI expertise; this is a natural knowledge exchange where Junfan can accelerate Pranav's agentic systems work while Pranav's full-stack perspective could inform Junfan's open-source community learning projects.
intro_message: Pranav Patel, meet Junfan Zhu — he's spent 5+ years building agentic AI systems and maintains LangGraph projects you should learn from, and your full-stack AI applications could benefit from his frameworks and mentorship on reinforcement learning and world models.
